reason: Original exact search for an M1.4 flanged nut in steel returned no exact flanged M1.4 product; the exact M1.4 result was a standard A1 stainless hex nut. The completed DIN 6923 refinement showed flanged nuts starting at M4 or M5 and larger. No eligible M1.4 non-stainless steel flanged nut appeared in either completed exact search.
search_evidence: First completed Google search: https://www.google.com/search?q=M1.4+flanged+nut+steel. Exact M1.4 supplier result was Accu's standard M1.4 DIN 934 stainless steel A1 hex nut; flange results were M4 or larger, with multiple M14 listings. Second completed Google search: https://www.google.com/search?q=M1.4+DIN+6923+steel+flange+nut. Results included DIN 6923 steel flange nut ranges and examples at M4 and above; no M1.4 steel flange nut.

attempts.outcome: No exact M1.4 flanged nut found. Exact M1.4 result was an A1 stainless standard hex nut; flanged candidates were M4 or larger.
No eligible M1.4 steel flanged nut found; DIN 6923 candidates shown were M4 or larger.
